spatialaudio.config.title: Spatial Audio Settings
spatialaudio.config.categories.title: Sound Category Settings
spatialaudio.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, HRTF, head tracking and acoustics all revert to vanilla behaviour.
spatialaudio.option.hrtf_mode.tooltip: HRTF reproduces 3D direction using head and ear filtering; it is the core of headphone spatial audio. Use "Force on" with AirPods. Changing it reloads the sound engine.
spatialaudio.option.hrtf_name.tooltip: Choose the HRTF dataset used by OpenAL Soft. Put .mhr files in ~/.local/share/openal/hrtf and reopen this screen to pick them.
spatialaudio.option.tracking_source.tool: Auto: read AirPods on macOS and also accept OpenTrack; AirPods: AirPods only; OpenTrack: any OpenTrack-compatible tracker; Off: no tracking.
spatialaudio.option.tracking_strength.to: How strongly head rotation moves the soundstage. 100% matches your real head motion 1:1.
spatialaudio.option.invert_yaw.tooltip: Calibration: enable if yaw reads negative when you turn left.
spatialaudio.option.invert_pitch.tooltip: Calibration: enable if pitch reads negative when you look up.
spatialaudio.option.invert_roll.tooltip: Calibration: enable if roll reads negative when you tilt right.
spatialaudio.option.recenter_mode.toolti: Full: the pose at recenter time becomes "facing the screen" (good for laptops); Yaw only: resets left/right only.
spatialaudio.option.drift_correction.too: Slowly removes gyroscope yaw drift while your head is roughly facing the screen and still.
spatialaudio.option.drift_seconds.toolti: Larger values correct more slowly and interfere less with deliberate head turns.
spatialaudio.option.prediction.tooltip: Extrapolates head pose using angular velocity to hide Bluetooth/mixing latency. Too high may overshoot on sudden stops.
spatialaudio.option.listener_rate.toolti: How often the listener orientation is refreshed, independent of frame rate.
spatialaudio.option.smoothing_cutoff.too: One Euro filter: lower is steadier at rest but adds latency.
spatialaudio.option.smoothing_beta.toolt: One Euro filter: higher keeps fast head turns more responsive.
Use head translation from OpenTrack 6DoF data (AirPods do not provide translation).
spatialaudio.option.udp_port.tooltip: Local port for head pose data; 4242 matches OpenTrack's default. Restart tracking to apply.
spatialaudio.option.udp_all_interfaces.t: Accept OpenTrack data from other devices on your network. Off (localhost only) is safer.
spatialaudio.option.anchor_to_screen.too: Keeps listener-relative sounds (music, UI) fixed towards the screen when you turn your head, like Apple Spatial Audio.
spatialaudio.option.spatialize_stereo.to: OpenAL does not position stereo files by default. When on, stereo sounds in the world (from resource packs or mods) are positioned in 3D too.
spatialaudio.option.acoustics.tooltip: Ray-traced reverb, echo, occlusion, diffraction, air absorption and medium filtering.
spatialaudio.option.respect_sound_physic: When Sound Physics Remastered is installed, let it handle acoustics; this mod keeps HRTF and head tracking only.
spatialaudio.option.reverb.tooltip: Real-time reverb from the size and materials of your surroundings (Eyring formula).
spatialaudio.option.echo.tooltip: Echoes from distant cliffs in valleys and canyons.
spatialaudio.option.occlusion.tooltip: Walls and blocks muffle and attenuate sound based on material and thickness.
spatialaudio.option.redirection.tooltip: Occluded sounds appear to come from doorways and corners they travel around.
spatialaudio.option.medium_filter.toolti: Muffles sounds while you are underwater, in lava or in powder snow.
spatialaudio.option.air_absorption.toolt: Distant sounds lose more high frequencies, especially in rain.
spatialaudio.option.doppler.tooltip: Pitch shift for moving sources and listener (e.g. flying past with elytra).
spatialaudio.option.probe_rays.tooltip: Rays per environment probe pass. More is more accurate but costs more.
spatialaudio.option.echo_distance.toolti: Maximum distance for finding echo surfaces.
spatialaudio.option.diffraction_cells.to: How many air blocks to search for a path around obstacles (doorways, windows, corridors) when a sound is occluded. 0 computes the direct path only.
spatialaudio.option.budget.tooltip: Maximum time per tick spent on acoustics; extra work is deferred.
spatialaudio.option.show_hud.tooltip: Show tracking status, head pose, HRTF and environment in the top-left corner.
spatialaudio.option.setup_hints.tooltip: Show recommended macOS/AirPods settings when joining a world.
Whether stereo sounds of this category are positioned in 3D.
spatialaudio.option.category.occlusion.t: Whether occlusion and diffraction apply to this category.
spatialaudio.option.category.reverb_send: How much of this category is sent to environmental reverb.
spatialaudio.option.category.screen_anch: Whether listener-relative sounds of this category stay anchored to the screen.
spatialaudio.status.waiting_for_data.hin: No pose data yet. On macOS make sure your AirPods are in; for OpenTrack set the output to "UDP over network" targeting 127.0.0.1:4242.
spatialaudio.status.helper_starting.hint: The AirPods head-tracking helper is starting. On first use macOS asks for Motion & Fitness access; click "Allow".
spatialaudio.status.helper_compiling.hin: First run: compiling the AirPods helper with Xcode Command Line Tools (10–60 s).
spatialaudio.status.helper_not_found.hin: This jar has no prebuilt helper and no Swift compiler was found. Use the jar from the Releases page or run xcode-select --install.
spatialaudio.status.helper_failed.hint: The AirPods helper could not be started. Check the game log or run it manually from the helper folder.
spatialaudio.status.helper_no_response.h: The helper started but sends nothing. It may be blocked by security software, or the UDP port is busy.
spatialaudio.status.helper_error.hint: CoreMotion reported an error. Reconnect your AirPods and click "Restart head tracking".
spatialaudio.status.unsupported_os.hint: AirPods head tracking needs macOS 14 Sonoma or newer. OpenTrack still works.
spatialaudio.status.not_available.hint: No head-motion data from this system or headphones. Supported: AirPods (3rd/4th gen), AirPods Pro, AirPods Max and some Beats.
spatialaudio.status.not_authorized.hint: Motion & Fitness access was denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Motion & Fitness and allow SpatialAudio Head Tracker.
spatialaudio.status.awaiting_authorizati: Allow SpatialAudio Head Tracker to access motion data in the macOS dialog.
spatialaudio.status.waiting_for_headphon: Put in head-tracking AirPods/Beats and make sure they are the current audio output.
spatialaudio.status.port_in_use.hint: The configured UDP port is in use; a temporary port is used, so OpenTrack cannot connect. Change the port in settings.
spatialaudio.status_line.acoustics: Acoustics: %s · enclosure %s · RT60 %s s · echo %s blocks · sources %s
spatialaudio.hint.airpods_detected: [Spatial Audio] AirPods detected: HRTF binaural rendering and head tracking are active. F6 recenters, F7 opens settings.
spatialaudio.hint.disable_system_spatial: Tip: in macOS Control Center → Sound (or the AirPods menu), set Spatial Audio for Java to "Off" so macOS does not spatialize the game a second time.
spatialaudio.hint.hrtf_off: [Spatial Audio] HRTF is off, so 3D direction will be weak. Set "HRTF mode" to "Force on" in Spatial Audio settings.
